units.source_text: “不是，我来拿沙子打比方是因为……

en.t: No, the reason I use sand as an example is because...

units.source_text: 说到底，世界不就像沙子一样吗……

en.t: After all, isn't the world just like sand...

units.source_text: 沙子这玩意儿，在静止状态下，很难抓住其本质……

en.t: Sand, when it is at rest, is very hard to grasp in its essence...

units.source_text: 沙子其实没有流动，只是流动这玩意儿叫做‘沙子’……

en.t: Sand is not really flowing; rather, that thing called flowing is what we call 'sand'...
I can never seem to explain it clearly..."
